reasons.claim: 1 eligible species within 250 m: Goodyera repens (VU vascular plant, site-bound, forest-associated), 3 records, nearest 47 m (2024), latest 2026, 10 m uncertainty. Its listed threats include lack of dead wood and increased openness of tree-covered land.

3 site-bound forest NT species are also within 250 m: Lobaria pulmonaria (35 m, 2026), Pseudographis pinicola (49 m), Hericium coralloides (236 m). This is fewer than the 3-NT-species threshold... actually it equals 3, but it is supporting evidence only since HIGH already applies.
No completed felling overlaps the 8.55 ha polygon, so not ALREADY_FELLED.
Effort is adequate (72nd percentile). There are 15 records within 250 m and none inside the polygon.

uncertainties: Only one eligible species, recorded outside the polygon. Whether it occurs in the stand is unknown.
No records inside the polygon, with 0 observation days there.
not_established: Presence or absence of species inside the polygon.
That the site is safe to fell.
next_action: Human reviewer should check the Goodyera repens and NT records (2024-2026) against the polygon edge and consider a field inventory before felling starts.
